This page lists pages that link a [[SWCCG Wiki:Disambiguation|disambiguation page]] instead of the exact card. Most are decklists whose source names a card title shared by two printings on the same side (for example the Premiere and Coruscant [[Sense]]) without saying which one. When a source shows the printing (a card image, a GEMP file, a set name), change the link to that card.
